name: Agent notes
summary: The agent writes its own notes through a memory tool and reads them back in later sessions, whichever channel the user reaches it on (CLI, Telegram, Slack). Notes are small and bounded, so the agent has to decide what is worth keeping.
how: Give the agent a memory tool with add, edit and remove actions
Store notes in a small file or record shared by all channels
Inject the notes into the system prompt at session start
Have the agent consolidate when the store is full
Pair with full-text search over past sessions for specifics
facts: Hermes Agent (MEMORY.md and USER.md), Claude Code (auto memory)
Bounded text files written by the agent
Hermes: 2,200 chars for agent notes, 1,375 for user profile
Cheap and transparent, but limited by what the agent chooses to write
goodFor: One agent reachable from several channels
Low-cost memory without an external service
watchOut: Hard size caps force the agent to drop older notes
Mid-session writes may not appear until the next session
